label: Millet 1556 — French

bibliography.author: Jean Millet, de Sainct Amour
bibliography.title: Les cinq livres de l’histoire d’Egesippe, contenans plusieurs guerres des Iuifs, & la ruine de Hierusalem
bibliography.imprint: Paris: Guillaume Cavellat, 1556. Printed by Benoist Prévost; colophon dated 17 January 1556.
bibliography.basis: French translation of the Latin De excidio Hierosolymitano, historically attributed to Hegesippus. Ussani (1932) supplies the modern correspondence framework; it is not claimed as Millet’s sixteenth-century exemplar.
